glitches_required.why: Higher settings put glitches you must perform into the logic.

mode.why: Inverted swaps the two worlds, which makes everything less familiar.

item_pool.why: Harder pools have fewer upgrades such as hearts and armor.

item_functionality.why: Harder settings make items less helpful.

enemy_health.why: Enemies take more hits to kill.

enemy_damage.why: Enemy damage is shuffled, and in chaos some enemies hit for up to eight hearts.

entrance_shuffle.why: The more entrances are shuffled, the less the map can be trusted.

timer.why: A running clock, and in the OHKO modes one hit ends the run.

pot_shuffle.why: Items can be hidden in pots.

bombless_start.why: You cannot use bombs until you find a bomb upgrade.

retro_bow.why: Arrows cost rupees and need a quiver.

crystals_needed_for_ganon.why: Fewer crystals to damage Ganon is an easier finish.

crystals_needed_for_gt.why: Fewer crystals to open Ganon's Tower is an easier path.

beemizer_total_chance.why: Junk items become bee swarm traps.

dark_room_logic.why: With none, dark rooms must be crossed without light.

death_link.why: When any player dies, everyone dies.

accessibility.why: Minimal accessibility only promises the goal can be finished.
